title: Starbucks Sparkle Green Stainless-Steel 24 Oz Tumbler w/ Lid & Straw
descriptionText: This stunning Starbucks tumbler is the perfect addition to any collection! Crafted from durable stainless steel, it features a vibrant teal color and Starbucks branding. The 24 oz size is perfect for your coffee or tea fix, and the sparkling green design will make it stand out in any display. This item is an original, authentic Starbucks product and is sure to delight any coffee or tea lover. Add it to your collection today!
